The handicap team race was won by our "A" Team with Demmon, Newson, Hall and Doubleday with an aggregate time of 206m.2s. Surrey W.C. were 2nd and Woodford Green 3rd.

John Knifton was 24th in Section A Barnes, Belderson, Beecham and Keown, 6th 7th 30th and 32nd respectively in Section B; Eglington, Cameron, McLennan, Duncan,Wilson and Doubleday between 18 and 62 in Section C; Bushman, East and Logan 14th,15th and 34th in Section D.

On April 29th 1944 Etienne (immediately becoming known as Steve) was elected a member of Belgrave Harriers and he found himself running alongside such notables as Carter, Cohen, Shields and Doubleday.
